titre: School meals (snack, canteen) and after-school care
resume: In Mayotte, most primary schools have no canteen but serve a snack, and few high schools have a school restaurant. What you need to know, the documents to prepare and where to ask for help.
aQuoiCaSert: In mainland France, most schools offer a canteen. In Mayotte, the situation is different: in primary education, pupils usually receive a snack (collation) rather than a hot meal, and in 2025 only two high schools (lycées) had a canteen, according to the parliamentary debates on the rebuilding of Mayotte (refondation de Mayotte). Ask the school or the town hall (mairie) what is served, how much it costs and what after-school care (périscolaire) is offered.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of children in nursery or primary school.
Parents of middle and high school students.
Parents of a child with an allergy or on a special diet for health reasons.
aSavoir: Primary education: the snack often replaces the meal. Families may be asked to contribute: the amount is set locally.
Where a school meal service exists, every child enrolled at the school has the right to use it; restricting it to children whose parents work is illegal.
In middle and high school, the canteen social fund (fonds social pour les cantines) can help families. It is granted by the head of the school.
Allergy or diet for health reasons: an individual care plan (PAI, projet d'accueil individualisé) can be set up with the doctor.
Separated parents: enrollment is part of the child's everyday life. Agree on who pays and note it in the Journal.

documents.detail: Copy, often requested for after-school care.

Judgment or residence agreement, if you are separated
documents.detail: Copy. Useful for the list of people allowed to pick up the child.

etapes.detail: Snack, meal, care before or after class: ask the school, the town hall or the middle or high school's bursar's office (intendance) for the prices and the documents.
Proof of income, proof of address, ID, insurance certificate, vaccination pages, PAI if needed, judgment if separated.
With the organization indicated by the school or the town hall.
In middle and high school, contact the social worker or the school office about the canteen social fund. In primary school, ask at the town hall.
In the Journal, to keep a history and make sharing with the other parent easier.
